Initial release of Sleep Environment Architect.

- Audit and improve all aspects of the sleep environment: light, sound, temperature, air, bedding, and room layout.
- Provides actionable guidance to create optimal conditions for sleep quality.
- Includes step-by-step assessment and targeted recommendations for common disruptors (light leakage, noise, uncomfortable temperatures, etc.).
- Suggests practical solutions across various budgets, from DIY fixes to specialized products.
- Designed for anyone aiming to optimize their bedroom environment for better sleep.
